home.tagline: A place for stories, poems and essays.
home.comingSoon: We're building the platform right now. Come back soon.

nav.logOutFailed: We couldn’t log you out. Check your connection and try again.

language.label: Language
language.keptOnDevice: We couldn't save the language to your account. It's kept on this device.

staff.everyActionLogged: Every action and sensitive read is logged.

notFound.heading: We can’t find that page
notFound.body: The link may be old, or the page was moved or deleted. Go back to Home to keep reading.

errorPage.heading: Something went wrong on our side
errorPage.body: It isn’t your fault. Try again. If it keeps happening, contact us and quote the error code if one is shown.
errorPage.whatWeSendLabel: What we send to our error log:
errorPage.whatWeSend: the type of error, the page and the app version. Never your email, your IP address or anything you wrote.

maintenance.heading: We’re updating {{productName}}
maintenance.body: You can’t read or post for a short while. Everything you saved before is safe.

offline.offline: You’re offline. Pages that need the internet won’t load until you’re back online.

pictures.held: A person on our moderation team will look at your picture before others can see it. We'll let you know.
pictures.pending: Your picture is uploaded. We'll check it as soon as we can; until then only you can see it.

failed.wrong_type: That file isn't a JPEG, PNG or WebP picture.
failed.too_big: That picture is too big. Choose a smaller one.
failed.too_many: You've uploaded a lot of pictures in the last hour. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
failed.not_allowed: You can't upload this picture right now.
failed.unreachable: We couldn't upload your picture. Check your connection and try again.
failed.rights_not_confirmed: Tick the box to confirm you have the right to use this picture.

pictures.coverHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. A tall picture (5 by 8) fits best. Readers see it once it passes our picture check.
pictures.coverRights: Only upload a picture you made or have the right to use.
pictures.avatarHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB. Others see it once it passes our picture check.

chapter.beingCheckedNote: It shows here once our picture check is done.
chapter.notLoaded: We couldn’t load this picture. Check your connection and refresh the page.

website.readFailed: We couldn't load this page's text. Check your connection and try again.

help.heading: How can we help?
help.intro: Short guides to writing, reading and staying safe here, and answers to the questions people ask most.
help.notFoundHeading: We can't find that help page
help.notFound: It may have moved or been taken down. All help pages are on the Help page.
